name: 퍼플렉시티 분석
description: Measures text perplexity to detect AI-generated text, which tends to have lower perplexity than human writing.
useCase: Detecting AI-generated text by measuring predictability of word sequences
mechanism: Calculates per-token perplexity using language models to measure how predictable each word is given its context. AI-generated text typically exhibits lower, more uniform perplexity because language models optimize for precisely this metric, while human text shows more variation and occasional surprising word choices.
source: Mitchell et al. (2023) - DetectGPT: Zero-Shot Machine-Generated Text Detection using Probability Curvature, ICML
algorithm: Language Model Perplexity Scoring + Statistical Threshold Analysis
parameters: Model: GPT-2 based, Context window: 1024 tokens, Scoring: per-token log probability, Threshold: adaptive
strengths:
• Does not require training on specific AI models
• Works across different AI text generators
• Fast inference with pre-trained models
• Can analyze text of any length
limitations:
• Less effective on edited or paraphrased AI text
• Domain-specific text may have naturally low perplexity
• Short texts provide less reliable signals
• Performance varies across languages

references.title: Mitchell, E. et al. (2023). DetectGPT: Zero-Shot Machine-Generated Text Detection using Probability Curvature. ICML.
Solaiman, I. et al. (2019). Release Strategies and the Social Impacts of Language Models. OpenAI Technical Report.
Gehrmann, S. et al. (2019). GLTR: Statistical Detection and Visualization of Generated Text. ACL Demo.
